description: This file contains implementation code for CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) algorithms, including functions for CRC calculation, table initialization, and CRC manipulation methods within the absl::crc_internal namespace.

classes.name: CRC
classes.description: Base class for CRC algorithms, providing interface and common methods.

classes.name: CRC32
classes.description: Implementation of CRC-32 algorithm with table-based extension, unextension, and scrambling methods.

methods.name: CRC::Crc32c
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of CRC with the standard CRC-32C polynomial.

methods.name: CRC32::InitTables
methods.description: Initializes lookup tables for CRC computation, including forward and reverse tables.

methods.name: CRC32::Extend
methods.description: Extends the CRC value with additional data bytes.

methods.name: CRC32::ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends the CRC value by a specified number of zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Reverses the extension of CRC by zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::Scramble
methods.description: Scrambles the CRC value for obfuscation.

methods.name: CRC32::Unscramble
methods.description: Reverses the scrambling of the CRC value.
